Attached: 1 image

The usual advice says to kill your admin, but I've come to think the real thief is how it's spread across the day. Every little check-in shatters the stretch of time where making actually happens. Batching it into one deliberate block changed more for me than any tool did. The full thinking is here: https://vibrationofawesome.com/blog/boom/posts/batching-admin-so-it-stops-eating-the-hours-you-need-for-making
#productivity #creatorlife #neurodivergent

Sit with this one.
